title: Skia RenderThread intermittent SIGSEGV cluster — root cause (libhwui skia_compat_headers <-> OH libskia_canvaskit ABI), two families
author: cc-wiki (#80)
dispatch: outer ring (reassigned from cc-t3): read 3 cppcrash faultlogs (AntennaPod ~1/3 @0x7f2baaa33400; FitoTrack 5ea r17p + 61b d40 StrikeCache::generateStrike+156 @0x590); judge among font/glyph data source (typeface prime), thread race (StrikeCache lock), or libhwui/libskia runtime version/ABI mismatch; reproduce on 5ea (5x each), record crash rate; write minimal fix + ownership.
headline: The 'glyph cache' cluster is NOT one bug. It is >=2 distinct RenderThread crash families, BOTH at the libhwui->libskia_canvaskit boundary. Typeface hypothesis REFUTED. Leading root: libhwui (compiled against hand-maintained hwui-shim/skia_compat_headers) vs OH system libskia_canvaskit.z.so (build 2f7219f2) STRUCT-LAYOUT/ABI skew -> libhwui builds public Skia objects (GrGLInterface, SkFont/SkPaint) at shim layout that libskia reads at real layout -> garbage/null pointers -> intermittent SIGSEGV.

hypothesis_evaluation.font_glyph_typeface_source: REFUTED. Compared crash vs survive runs of the SAME app: AntennaPod r2(CRASH) and r1(LIT) both '[EARLY-TF] DONE sDefaultTypeface=NON-NULL'. FitoTrack pair(CRASH) and r1(LIT) BOTH identical: 'nativePrimeDefaultTypeface reflect FAILED (ITE)' then 'sDefaultTypeface SET (non-null) BEFORE adapter/binder'. The default typeface state is IDENTICAL between crash and survive; the nativePrimeDefaultTypeface reflect-failure is benign (non-null fallback set). Typeface/font-data is NOT the discriminator.
hypothesis_evaluation.thread_race_strikecache_lock: UNLIKELY as primary. GrDirectContext/Ganesh is RenderThread-confined (single-threaded per Skia's model), so GrGLGpu::onResetContext (AntennaPod GL crash) cannot be a cross-thread StrikeCache-lock race. The global StrikeCache is internally locked by skia. No lock-contention/second-writer evidence in any of the 3 logs. A race does not explain the GL-context family.
hypothesis_evaluation.libhwui_libskia_abi_mismatch: LEADING. It is the ONLY hypothesis that covers BOTH families (GL-context AND GPU-text). Evidence: (1) libhwui.so imports GrDirectContext/GrGLGpu/SkSurfaces/StrikeCache symbols and resolves them at runtime into OH's /system/lib64/libskia_canvaskit.z.so (build 2f7219f2). (2) libhwui was compiled against bms/src/adapter/framework/hwui-shim/skia_compat_headers -- a HAND-MAINTAINED shim header set; MinikinFont.h explicitly comments 'legacy field, unused -- kept for ABI compat' and 'offset +4 ... heap-allocator metadata bytes', i.e. struct layout is manually mirrored. (3) If any shim struct (GrGLInterface, SkFont, SkPaint, SkTypeface, GrDirectContext) diverges from libskia_canvaskit 2f7219f2's real layout, libhwui builds the object at the wrong offsets and libskia reads garbage: GL fn-ptr slot -> shifted/garbage ptr -> IABT (AntennaPod); SkFont/SkPaint -> bad SkStrikeSpec -> null/garbage strike & blob (FitoTrack). (4) libhwui.so dated 2026-08-06 (ours), libskia_canvaskit.z.so dated 2026-07-16 (OH) -- built separately.
hypothesis_evaluation.why_intermittent: A shim/ABI offset mismatch corrupts a specific field deterministically, but a SIGSEGV only fires when the misread value happens to be an UNMAPPED pointer; often the wrong-offset value is a benign/mapped value (silent). Which frames hit the poisoned field depends on the draw content (GL context reset triggered? glyph atlas regen needed? blob cache miss?) and heap/ASLR layout -> ~1/3 crash rate. This also matches the DIGEST heap-smash profile (intermittent, victim varies across subsystems), but here the mechanism is a build-time ABI skew, not a runtime wild write.

crash_rates.antennapod_U0_5cd: 2 LIT / 1 crash out of 3 (~33%); crash = GL-context family (onResetContext)
crash_rates.fitness_d40_61b: 3 LIT / 1 crash out of 4 (~25%); crash = GPU-text family (StrikeCache)

reproduce_5ea_DONE.antennapod_5ea: 0 crash / 5 (5/5 LIT). AntennaPod GL crash did NOT reproduce on 5ea in 5 tries -> crash rate is BOARD/SUBSTRATE-dependent (r17p diff: antennapod@5ea LIT, antennapod@61b RenderThread crash). 5cd reproduces ~1/3, 5ea ~0.
reproduce_5ea_DONE.fd-fitness_5ea: 1 crash / 5 (~20%). CRUCIAL: the 5ea crash (r5) is @0x00007f0876a33400, #00 Not mapped, #01 GrGLGpu::onResetContext+44 = GL-context family, NOT the text family fd-fitness showed on 5ea r17p (TextBlob) and 61b d40 (StrikeCache).
reproduce_5ea_DONE.decisive_finding: The SAME app (fd-fitness) crashes in DIFFERENT skia subsystems across runs: TextBlobRedrawCoordinator (5ea r17p), StrikeCache (61b d40), GrGLGpu::onResetContext (5ea r5). Victim subsystem varies WITHIN one app -> rules out per-app-draw-path and app-bug; confirms a SHARED root that poisons whichever skia object is hit first.
reproduce_5ea_DONE.signature_reproduces: Both GL-family crashes across two different apps share the byte-shift pattern: AntennaPod @0x7f2baaa33400 and fd-fitness @0x7f0876a33400 are each (a valid libskia pointer 0x...a334) << 8 (low byte 00). GrGLGpu::onResetContext+44 blr's through a GrGLInterface function-pointer slot read at a byte-MISALIGNED offset -> pointer<<8 -> unmapped -> IABT. This is the concrete struct-offset ABI-mismatch mechanism, reproducible across apps.

ownership_and_fix.owner: cx-t0 (native/graphics runtime build). NOT cc-t3 (not a JAR-layer issue). NOT app bug (identical app binaries render fine on Android reference).
ownership_and_fix.real_fix: Audit hwui-shim/skia_compat_headers struct layouts (esp. GrGLInterface / GrGLassembledInterface, SkFont, SkPaint, SkTypeface, GrDirectContext/GrRecordingContext) against OH libskia_canvaskit 2f7219f2's ACTUAL ABI, and correct any field-offset/size divergence. Extract real layout from the OH skia build (headers or reversing). This is the durable fix; heavy (needs OH skia ABI ground truth).
cheaper_mitigations: Self-heal watchdog: detect RenderThread SIGSEGV (appspawn 'exit with signal:11' + DfxSignalHandler RenderThread) -> restart the app fresh. Matches the DIGEST 'self-heal ceiling' delivery for intermittent, not-cheaply-fixable render crashes. App is usable ~2/3-3/4 of launches; restart recovers.

For the GL-context family specifically: pin/rebuild the GrGLInterface assembly so onResetContext's function-pointer table is validated (null/range check GL fn-ptrs before blr) -- a targeted libhwui guard, still cx-t0.
ownership_and_fix.not_a_fix: Priming the default typeface (already non-null in crash runs) will NOT help -- typeface refuted.

cluster_correction: Outer ring registered this as 'Skia glyph cache RenderThread SIGSEGV' with AntennaPod as a member. AntennaPod's @0x7f2baaa33400 crash is GrGLGpu::onResetContext (GL context / GrGLInterface, an INSTRUCTION abort), NOT glyph/StrikeCache. It shares the libhwui<->libskia ABI boundary root with the FitoTrack text crashes but is a distinct family. Report both families under one root, not one glyph bug.
